From bae69bfa3a586493469078ec4ca35499b754ba5c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2020 11:09:30 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] clk: meson: Kconfig: fix dependency for G12A

When building only G12A, ensure that VID_PLL_DIV clock driver is
selected, otherwise results in this build error:

ERROR: modpost: "meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops" [drivers/clk/meson/g12a.ko] undefined!

Fixes: 085a4ea93d54 ("clk: meson: g12a: add peripheral clock controller")
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Jerome Brunet <jbrunet@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201118190930.34352-1-khilman@baylibre.com

diff --git a/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig b/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
index 034da203e8e0..9a8a548d839d 100644
--- a/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig
@@ -110,6 +110,7 @@ config COMMON_CLK_G12A
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_AO_CLKC
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_EE_CLKC
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_CPU_DYNDIV
+	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
 	select MFD_SYSCON
 	help
 	  Support for the clock controller on Amlogic S905D2, S905X2 and S905Y2
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/clk/meson/Kconfig`**
   - A new line was added to the configuration for `COMMON_CLK_G12A`:
     ```plaintext
     + select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
     ```
   - This modification ensures that the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver is selected when building for the G12A configuration.

### Relationships

- The modification in the `Kconfig` file addresses a build error that occurs when the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver is not selected while building only for G12A. The error message indicates that the `meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops` symbol is undefined, which is resolved by explicitly selecting the `COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV` in the configuration. This change is a direct fix for the issue introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `085a4ea93d54`).

Here is the commit message:
clk: meson: Kconfig: fix dependency for G12A

When building only G12A, ensure that VID_PLL_DIV clock driver is
selected, otherwise results in this build error:

ERROR: modpost: "meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops" [drivers/clk/meson/g12a.ko] undefined!

Fixes: 085a4ea93d54 ("clk: meson: g12a: add peripheral clock controller")
Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Signed-off-by: Jerome Brunet <jbrunet@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201118190930.34352-1-khilman@baylibre.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by the absence of the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver selection in the `Kconfig` for the `COMMON_CLK_G12A` configuration. This omission leads to an undefined symbol error during the build process when the G12A clock controller is being compiled, as the necessary dependencies for the clock operations are not met.

Here is the patch:
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_EE_CLKC
 	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_CPU_DYNDIV
+	select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
 	select MFD_SYSCON
 	help

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
select COMMON_CLK_MESON_EE_CLKC
select COMMON_CLK_MESON_CPU_DYNDIV
```
Reason:
The absence of `select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV` in the `Kconfig` for the `COMMON_CLK_G12A` configuration means that the necessary clock driver for `VID_PLL_DIV` is not included during the build process. This results in the undefined symbol error for `meson_vid_pll_div_ro_ops`, as the build system cannot find the required clock operations for the G12A clock controller.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
+select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV
```
Reason:
By adding `select COMMON_CLK_MESON_VID_PLL_DIV` to the `Kconfig`, the build system is instructed to include the `VID_PLL_DIV` clock driver when building the G12A clock controller. This ensures that all necessary dependencies are met, preventing the undefined symbol error during the build process.
